main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x (5-bar forward return minus coin's mean 5-bar return), non-overlapping grid, non-zero forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 on at least 30 cases; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 on at least 30 cases

decided_by: Fewer than 90% of non-zero-forecast bars are flat-range bars (30-bar net move <= 0.33 of the range) with the forecast on the side opposite to the close's distance from the range middle.
reading: Net move taken as |close[t] - close[t-29]| over the 30-bar high-low range of rows t-29..t (falling back to the recorded regime on bars with under 30 recorded bars), expected side short when the raw mid distance is above 0 and long below; the coin's mean 5-bar return is taken on the same non-overlapping grid over all its windows; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases' is reported as not observable per the workflow's minimum-count rule.
